decision.selection_rationale: A repository-owned deterministic SPDX 2.3 JSON generator best fits exact ordering, final-package reconciliation, explicit unresolved-state handling, and fail-closed policy requirements. Syft is the preferred later comparator because its pinned official sources directly support SPDX 2.3 JSON plus Windows, filesystem, archive, Python, and native-binary discovery, while publishing release checksums and provenance. Microsoft sbom-tool remains secondary because its pinned release documents SPDX 2.2 and 3.0 rather than the required SPDX 2.3 target.

fail_closed_conditions: unresolved distributed file without explicit unresolved record
input_properties: package URL or absence with reason
